newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan closed-end funds up on dividend hope.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan closed-end funds up on dividend hope.

text.p: Taiwan's closed-end fund shares rose at mid-morning on Thursday on hopes that they would issue high cash dividends in February or March 1997, brokers said.
After 80 minutes of trading, Jardine Fleming Fund rose 25 cents or 2.22 percent to T$11.55 and Fubon Fund gained 30 cents or 2.55 percent to T$12.1.

"Due to the sound performance of Taiwan's stock market in 1996, these closed-end funds are expected to each issue high cash dividends of around T$2 to T$3 per share in February or March 1997," said Michael Hung, research chief at Nikko Securities.
